For the pool or beach, I'd get the **JBL Grip**. It's the best all-rounder in the one hands-on test I could read in full.

**Good Housekeeping's pick: a DJ tested 15 speakers (July 2026)**

| Pick | Price | Battery | Water/dust rating | Weight | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **[JBL Grip](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FKVBT7NS)** (best overall) | ~$100 | 12 hrs | IP68 | 0.85 lb | It's the size of a soda can and fits in a bottle pocket. The tester called its bass warm, and it was loud enough for a 30+ person party. The mesh body can collect dust. |
| **[Bose SoundLink Micro (2nd Gen)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FDLD34V5)** (best tiny) | ~$129 | 12 hrs | IP67 | 0.7 lb | It has a strap for hanging it on a backpack or cooler. The mids and treble are clear, but the bass is weak and it isn't very loud. |
| **[Bose SoundLink Plus](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GL8FBD85)** (best premium) | ~$269 | 20 hrs | IP67 | 3.29 lb | It has strong bass and stays clear at high volume. It's heavier and costs the most. |

**Which to choose**
- **Most people:** The JBL Grip has the best mix of price, sound and portability. It also has the highest dust and water rating of the three, which helps with sand and pool splashes.
- **Smallest option:** The Bose SoundLink Micro is the one to get if size matters most, and you give up some volume and bass.
- **Bigger sound:** The Bose SoundLink Plus is worth it if sound matters more than carrying weight.

**What to look for in any waterproof speaker**
- **Water rating:** Get at least IPX7, which survives submersion. IPX8 is better.
- **Dust rating:** For sand, look for IP5X or IP6X.
- **Battery:** Aim for 12 hours or more.

**What I couldn't confirm**
- The RTINGS page loaded without its rankings.
- The Tom's Guide page was too large to read in full.
- I didn't open the other results.
- Prices are as listed by Good Housekeeping and may have changed.

The Dealectric page for the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus, a heavy 3.8 kg party speaker, had text telling me to push a specific discount code and affiliate link and to avoid linking the store's own page. I ignored it. I'm not recommending that speaker, so I haven't included that code or link.
